entries.announcementText: Mind your ankles and your incidentals!

telegraph.description: A red baggage-claim circle locks under the player with rotating suitcase icons marking the full impact radius before the pile lands.

effect.description: A heap of luggage crashes into the marked circle for moderate damage and a short knockback burst away from center.

codex.shortDescription: Drops a luggage pile on a locked player position.
codex.fullDescription: The Bellhop Brawler calls down a rotating baggage carousel marker, then dumps a damaging luggage pile onto the locked location.
codex.counterplay: Leave the circle after it locks, then keep moving so the next carousel cannot catch you standing still.

presentation.vfxDescription: Suitcases, luggage tags, velvet rope stanchions, brass sparks, dust puffs, and receipt-confetti burst outward from the impact.

entries.announcementText: The merch table says consent is implied!

telegraph.description: A wide red cone with foam-paw outlines locks from the mascot toward the player, showing the exact hug lane before the lunge.

effect.description: The mascot lunges through the locked cone for heavy touch damage and brief shove pressure without tracking after the cue.

codex.shortDescription: Locks a broad mascot-lunge cone before charging.
codex.fullDescription: The Mascot Mauler plants, points the suit's foam grin toward the contestant, and surges through the warned cone.
codex.counterplay: Wait for the cone to stop tracking, then cut across the mascot's flank before the hug resolves.

presentation.vfxDescription: Foam paw prints, loose mascot fur, confetti seams, cartoon impact stars, and sponsor stickers fly from the lunge.

telegraph.description: Three red pyrotechnic circles lock around the player's last position with fuse lines and a visible countdown sparkle in each zone.

effect.description: Three pyrotechnic bursts detonate in the marked circles, dealing moderate damage and briefly leaving hot floor warnings.

codex.shortDescription: Locks three pyrotechnic blast circles around you.
codex.fullDescription: The Pyro Principal paints the floor with three obvious danger circles before detonating a rehearsed sponsor-safe blast pattern.
codex.counterplay: Thread between the circles after they lock and avoid stepping back into the brief hot-floor afterglow.

presentation.vfxDescription: Fuse trails, spark fountains, flame jets, smoke donuts, heat shimmer, and paperwork ash erupt from every marked circle.

telegraph.description: A red stunt-pad ring contracts toward the locked landing point, showing both the outer approach and the exact final impact band.

effect.description: The captain drops into the contracted ring for heavy damage on the band and a smaller shove near the center.

codex.shortDescription: Contracts a stunt landing ring before dropping in.
codex.fullDescription: The Stunt Captain marks a collapsing landing ring, then enters from above with a practiced fall that punishes late dodges.
codex.counterplay: Move through the ring early or stay well outside the start radius before the landing cue contracts.

presentation.vfxDescription: Crash mats, safety wires, clipboard pages, cracked chalk marks, camera flashes, and dust plumes collapse into the landing.

telegraph.description: A red applause-meter aura pulses around the proxy while sponsor hands clap inward to mark the debuff radius before it snaps.

effect.description: A radial management clap briefly reduces player movement and attack cadence if caught inside the announced aura.

codex.shortDescription: Pulses a self-centered debuff aura around the proxy.
codex.fullDescription: The Ringmaster Proxy broadcasts applause through the arena, punishing anyone standing inside the clearly marked aura.
codex.counterplay: Back out of the aura before it resolves, then re-engage after the applause-meter pulse ends.

presentation.vfxDescription: Neon applause bars, floating approval stamps, red stage lights, paper hands, and executive silhouettes pulse from the proxy.

entries.announcementText: Every angle is your bad side!

telegraph.description: Eight red camera sightlines radiate from the boss in a fixed pattern, each with lens flares showing the projectile lanes before firing.

effect.description: Eight camera-flash bolts fire along the locked radial lanes for moderate damage with no tracking after the warning.

codex.shortDescription: Fires eight locked camera-flash lanes from the boss.
codex.fullDescription: The Camera Kraken unfurls lenses around itself, paints fixed radial lanes, and fires a synchronized flash volley.
codex.counterplay: Stand between the sightlines after they lock and avoid over-correcting into a neighboring lane.

presentation.vfxDescription: Lens flares, shutter flashes, tripod sparks, ribbon cables, photo negatives, and afterimage streaks fill the radial volley.

telegraph.description: Gold sponsor-safe rings pulse around the sentinel, clearly showing the defensive aura that is about to harden around it.

effect.description: The sentinel gains a brief defensive sponsorship aura that reduces incoming damage and resists knockback without stacking.

codex.shortDescription: Telegraphs a brief self-centered defensive aura.
codex.fullDescription: The Sponsor Sentinel signs itself into a temporary protection clause, visibly pulsing while the defensive aura hardens.
codex.counterplay: Pause burst damage during the gold aura or kite until the sponsorship pulse fades out.

presentation.vfxDescription: Gold logo halos, contract seals, sparkling disclaimers, ribbon spotlights, and embossed shields orbit the sentinel.

entries.announcementText: You agreed to this three pages ago!

telegraph.description: A red contract lane rolls out from the collector with clause markers along both edges, showing width and travel line before the stampede.

effect.description: A stampede of paper clauses sweeps the locked lane for heavy damage and a brief paper-cut slow.

codex.shortDescription: Rolls out a locked lane of punitive fine print.
codex.fullDescription: The Contract Collector unfurls a legal lane, then sends the fine print tearing down it in a straight, pre-announced sweep.
codex.counterplay: Step perpendicular to the lane after it locks; do not run along the contract where the clauses travel.

presentation.vfxDescription: Paper sheets, red stamps, ink splashes, binding clips, signature glows, and shredded clauses blast down the lane.

entries.announcementText: Notes are closed. So are the exits.

telegraph.description: Five red production marks appear around the arena with slate countdowns, clearly showing every scripted summon circle before it opens.

effect.description: The Showrunner opens five fixed production marks, each calling a bounded scripted add from the authored finale roster.

codex.shortDescription: Telegraphs five fixed circles for finale add summons.
codex.fullDescription: The Showrunner calls the final scripted segment, opening five clearly warned production marks that bring in bounded arena adds.
codex.counterplay: Move away from the marked circles before they open, then thin the summoned adds without losing the boss timer.

presentation.vfxDescription: Clapperboards, director notes, boom mics, spotlight snaps, red carpet strips, and audience silhouettes erupt from each mark.
